subject: Request: Starlight pilot announcement — limited attribution + deal concession
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ana Gomez <ana@starlighthealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Starlight pilot announcement — limited attribution + deal concession

Ana — thanks again for the pilot kickoff yesterday. Quick ask as we scope the commercial: Starlight is a strategic win for Q3 and the AE team has proposed the following trade for an accelerated signature:

- Commercial concession: 25% credit applied to year‑one committed usage (applies at invoice time)
- Marketing concession we’re asking for: permission to (a) use Starlight logo on our customers page and (b) publish a short 150–200 word case excerpt on our site and in one co‑authored blog (no press release).

We’ve included the MOU with the concession language attached (Starlight_MOU_v2.pdf) and a draft one‑pager for marketing. Could you confirm whether logo usage + short excerpt is acceptable to Starlight? If you prefer, Ana, they suggested instead a co‑hosted webinar in lieu of logo placement — open to whichever you prefer.

We need internal approvals on the 25% credit and the marketing ask by EOD today to hit the customer’s procurement timeline. Marissa / Karthik: looping you for deal desk and marketing signoff. Laura — can you advise on any marketing policy constraints?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555‑0172

Attachments: Starlight_MOU_v2.pdf (stub)
From: Ana Gomez <ana@starlighthealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Starlight pilot announcement — limited attribution + deal concession

Jordan — appreciate the clear summary. A couple quick notes from our side:

1) We are OK with a logo on a customer page and a short excerpt, but we need the logo treatment to follow our brand guidelines and we cannot be in any press release or paid marketing.
2) Procurement will still need a PO and standard SOW; discounts above 20% require board notification on our side, so the 25% ask may slow approvals.
3) We like the webinar idea — co‑hosting a product webinar would be useful for our clinical ops team.

If you can lock the logo usage to product pages only (no press) and limit the public quote to that short excerpt, we can try to expedite.

Best,
Ana Gomez
Head of Partnerships, Starlight Health
ana.gomez@starlighthealth.com | +1 617 555 2424
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ana Gomez <ana@starlighthealth.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Starlight pilot announcement — limited attribution + deal concession

Thanks Ana — that clarifies. Per Ana: logo on customer page + short excerpt only, no press/promo; procurement flagged the >20% discount as a potential internal escalator at Starlight.

Karthik / Marissa — can we get a fast path decision here? Options I’m proposing for internal approval:

A) Approve 25% year‑one credit + marketing usage limited to product/customer page + 12‑month attribution window (no press).
B) Approve 20% year‑one credit + co‑hosted webinar + 6‑month logo usage (lower discount, more lift).

Attached the negotiated MOU for signatures. If we can land A we keep the original pricing; B is fallback and still closes this quarter. Starlight expects confirmation today to get PO out.

Jordan

---
Starlight_MOU_v2.pdf (attached stub)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: Starlight pilot announcement — limited attribution + deal concession

Team — quick internal note from Deal Desk: current discount bands in policy cap standard approvals at 20% for field. Anything >20% is an executive exception and needs signoff from Sales leadership. Given the marketing ask (logo + excerpt) is low‑risk if scoped tightly, my recommendation is:

- Approve a 20% year‑one credit without additional commercial locking (meets standard delegated authority).
- For any approval >20% (i.e., the 25% Jordan is asking), require Vivek to approve with the following conditions in writing:
  1) Usage duration capped at 12 months and limited to product/customer page and case study PDF only.
  2) No press release or paid social promotions.
  3) Legal confirms a short release language and signs off on the excerpt.
  4) CS to confirm baseline CSAT >= 8.0 before marketing publishes.

Laura — I’ve attached Starlight’s logo guidelines (customer-logo-guidelines.pdf) — marketing should confirm whether the requested placement fits our co‑brand rules.

Marissa / Jordan — please route this to Vivek for a quick yes/no. We need a recorded exec decision for the deal desk ledger (deal_id RW-2027-2345).

Attachments: customer-logo-guidelines.pdf (stub)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Starlight pilot announcement — limited attribution + deal concession

Thanks for the clear framing, Karthik. I’ll approve an exception but with constraints to protect runway and precedent:

- Commercial approval: Authorize 20% credit for year‑one committed usage. I will not approve 25% here without more commercial guardrails.
- Marketing swap: Approve 6 months of logo usage on a customer page + inclusion in a single co‑authored case excerpt (up to 200 words). No press release, no paid promotion.
- Additional programmatic lift: If Jordan wants to close at 25% instead, swap that incremental 5% for a co‑hosted webinar and a short joint webinar case study; legal must sign off and CS must confirm NPS/CSAT >= 8.5 prior to publication.

Karthik — please log the decision in the deal ledger under RW-2027-2345 and send a short exec approval note to legal for the limited publicity language. Marissa — Jordan, move forward with option B as the binding offer (20% + webinar + 6 month usage).

Vivek Kulkarni
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | (415) 555‑0133

[Internal approval recorded: Vivek Kulkarni — 2027-05-29T16:02:00Z]
